regulations.enforcement_body: City of Colorado Springs Planning Department
regulations.notes: Colorado Springs requires an annual STR permit ($125/year) plus a sales tax license. Owner-occupied STRs require operator to live at the property at least 185 days per year. Non-owner-occupied STRs are permitted but subject to use permit review. A floor plan and proof of ownership are required in the application. Conditions to protect neighborhood character may be attached.
